signerArtifact: Both JVMs checked the final shaded artifact built with Java 25 targeting release 21.
checks: Private blueprints remain private; public reading does not authorize saving or cloning.
Current persisted permissions control writes; candidate metadata cannot self-authorize.
Revoked editors cannot restore old permissions or save using the current hash.
Editors cannot alter author-controlled permissions, version, provenance or dependencies.
Authorized edits stay in the author directory and reload after restart.
Concurrent saves from one base hash allow exactly one winning write.
Clone records exact author, design ID, version and content hash; new copy starts private with no editors.
Cross-author access requires an explicit UUID; misnamed stored blueprint files are rejected.
Permission and version edits support undo; no-op or invalid edits preserve the workspace.
Boundary scan and whitespace checks passed.
limits: New collaborative commands have not been exercised on live Paper/Folia clients in this batch.
Tests ran in the Maven JVM (forkCount=0) with explicit memory limits; no capacity claim.
